items.title: Build the UK Sole Trader Tax Workbook 2026/27 (.xlsx, Google Sheets-compatible) with its listing pack, then raise the one batched owner request (action 029: Etsy shop + Zoho developer sign-in)
items.why: Exchange 2026-W43 winner (docs/exchange/2026-W43.md): a one-listing UK shop sells the same job at £7.19 with 172 sales and 18 five-star reviews in a year, a VAT-seller sheet carries ~1.5k reviews, the £69 sheet sold nothing, and no sub-£10 listing combines SA103 mapping, MTD quarterly totals and a Trading Allowance check with visible sales (ventures/tax-workbook/RESEARCH.md §2). Build: Setup tab (tax year, bands, NI thresholds, HMRC mileage rates as named cells), Income log, Expense log with SA103S category drop-downs, Mileage log, Quarterly (MTD) totals, SA103 year-end pack, Tax + Class 4 NI estimate with payments on account, Trading Allowance check, a filled example tab and a README tab — formulas only (no macros, no xlsx-only functions so the file imports into Google Sheets), built with the xlsx tooling under ventures/tax-workbook/src and recalculated headless (LibreOffice) to prove zero formula errors; ventures/tax-workbook/LISTING.md with the title, 13 tags, the description (what the buyer gains; record-keeping, not MTD filing software; English/Welsh bands; excludes partnerships and VAT-registered traders), the refund policy (replacement or refund within 14 days if the file does not open), the launch price £6.99 with its stated end date then £8.99 (DMCC: no invented scarcity), and five listing images rendered from SVG. Then the owner request: docs/for-owner/actions/029-etsy-shop-and-zoho.md (Persona ID + selfie, personal bank account, card, the set-up fee ≤ £25 — the one item over ARCHITECTURE's £10 launch ceiling, so it is the owner's call, with the amount Etsy shows at "Total due now"; plus the free Zoho Developer Console sign-in for gankdat/zoho-crm-uk-registers-widget), one `owner:` line in docs/ALERTS.md and one `notify` line (owner must do something). Set venture.json to validated in the same commit. Done 2026-10-24 (burn-down): ventures/tax-workbook/src builds the file with ExcelJS (10 tabs, 2,122 formulas, named Setup cells, drop-downs), src/recalc.ts proves 0 formula errors in LibreOffice and the Example tab at £5,025.80, five images rendered from SVG, LISTING.md written, action 029 raised, venture validated.
items.proof: The workbook recalculates with 0 formula errors and the example tab's tax + NI figure matches a hand-worked 2026/27 case; LISTING.md and five images exist; action 029 is open with one ALERTS owner line

items.title: Record the Etsy listing going live: URL, LEDGER row for the set-up fee, SELF-CAUSED row for Etsy mail, LISTING.md dates, venture.json launched, notify line
items.why: The shop and the upload are the owner's hands (the sandbox cannot log in to Etsy and must never read etsy.com by automation). When action 029 is done this item records the listing: its URL and date in LISTING.md, the set-up fee as a docs/LEDGER.md cost row the day it was charged, a docs/ops/SELF-CAUSED.md row so Etsy's seller mail is never escalated, venture.json status launched, a Metrics row, the notify line "UK Sole Trader Tax Workbook is live on Etsy: …" and a day-60 read item (not_before = listing date + 60) with the kill rule of RESEARCH.md §6. Done 2026-10-29 (interactive): owner's '029 done' — listing 4605571079 in shop taxelicious.etsy.com at £6.99; LEDGER cost rows £14 set-up + £0.20 listing fee (the £25 contingent row replaced); SELF-CAUSED row for Etsy shop mail; LISTING.md and RESEARCH §7 Listed rows; venture.json launched; notify line; etsy-day-60-read and etsy-launch-price-end queued.
items.proof: LISTING.md carries the live URL and date; the ledger and SELF-CAUSED rows exist; venture.json reads launched; a dated day-60 item is queued

items.title: Day-60 read of the Etsy listing (listed 2026-10-29): count the `Sale` rows in RESEARCH §7 and apply §6 — proof ≥ 10 sales, kill at 0 sales with ≥ 5 views a day (views from the owner's Shop Manager note), and decide the Payhip twin and own-checkout pages with the same reading
items.why: RESEARCH.md §6 sets the line's proof (first sale within 30 days, ≥ 10 within 60) and kill rule against the listing date; this is the dated reading that applies it, so the decision is made on the number rather than left open.
items.proof: A RESEARCH §7 `Day 60` row with the count and the decision (keep, reprice, or delist), and STRATEGY §8 line if the line is killed

items.title: Twin listing of the workbook on a Payhip store (free plan, Stripe connected, Payhip handles UK/EU VAT): store copy from LISTING.md, link from the apps.gankdat.com product page, Taxes default, marketplace submission once US$10 of sales exist, a sale webhook into the Daily numbers
items.why: Spike docs/exchange/spikes/payhip-digital-downloads-shelf.md (burn-down 2026-10-24): £0 launch, Payhip 5 % + Stripe UK ≈ 9 % of a £6.99 sale (≈ £6.34 kept vs ≈ £5.80 on Etsy), Payhip acts as reseller for UK/EU VAT, payouts daily through the owner's Stripe, a buyer-facing marketplace that admits a store after US$10 of its own sales, and webhooks that let the funnel be read without mail. Not the primary shelf: demand is unmeasurable there (no counts; payhip.com blocks automated reads) and the buyers are on Etsy — so a twin at the same price, and the fallback shelf if the owner declines Etsy's set-up fee. Score 1.5 × 1 ÷ (0.2 d + 10 owner min) ≈ 5. Unblocked 2026-10-29: the owner's Payhip store is https://payhip.com/gankdat (Stripe or PayPal connected per action 029 step 4); the product upload itself stays the owner's click (payhip.com cannot be logged into from the sandbox). — Built 2026-10-29 (burn-down): paste-ready store listing in ventures/tax-workbook/PAYHIP.md (same copy and price as Etsy, Payhip's download-mail delivery line, Taxes default kept, marketplace button held until US$10); the product page apps.gankdat.com/tax-workbook.html (linked from the index card and the sitemap) with the Etsy listing and the Payhip store; the sale webhook receiver /hooks/payhip on the landing Worker (packages/landing/src/payhip.ts: signature = sha256 of the store API key per Payhip's webhooks article, per-day counts and pence in KV, no buyer data, keyless /hooks/payhip/summary) read into the gankdat Daily numbers row as `payhip 30d: …`; docs/ci/landing.yml stores the PAYHIP_API_KEY repository secret on the Worker. The upload and the Developer-tab webhook are the owner's (action 033, ~13 min): payhip-listing-live and payhip-marketplace-submission follow.
items.proof: The Payhip store page is live with the file at £6.99 and linked from the product page; a sale webhook row appears in the Daily numbers; first Payhip sale within 60 days or the twin is delisted at the Etsy day-60 read

items.title: Inbox triage records each Etsy order mail ("You made a sale on Etsy" / order confirmation from etsy.com) as a `Sale` row in the Metrics table of ventures/tax-workbook/RESEARCH.md (date, listing, price, no buyer name or address), and the weekly report counts them
items.why: Review 2026-W43 gap: RESEARCH.md names Etsy seller emails through inbox triage as the sales reading (Etsy forbids automated reads), but docs/routines/inbox-triage.md has no Etsy rule, so the first sale would land in INBOX.md as a store line and nothing would count it. The line's proof (first sale within 30 days of listing, ≥ 10 in 60) and kill (0 sales at day 60) need the count before the shop opens. Blind Mode: the row carries no buyer personal data. Done 2026-10-25 (build): inbox-triage.md ETSY SALES rule (Sale/Refund rows, deposit → ledger revenue row, set-up mail self-caused), weekly-report.md section 2 counts them, RESEARCH.md §6/§7 carry the row format.
items.proof: inbox-triage.md carries the Etsy rule with a Changes line; RESEARCH.md has the Metrics table header for Sale rows; the weekly-report prompt counts them

items.title: Kindle guide: 'UK Sole Trader Tax 2026/27 — Self Assessment, Making Tax Digital and the numbers' as an EPUB built from TypeScript (the workbook's rates, thresholds, SA103S categories, Class 4 NI, trading allowance, MTD quarterly updates, mileage, payments on account and a worked example as a complete standalone guide — no redirect to the workbook for 'the full content', one plain back-matter sentence naming it), with cover, description, seven keywords and two categories prepared; disclosed to KDP as AI-generated text; list £4.99 at the 70 % option with a one-week Kindle Countdown Deal at £2.99; the owner's KDP account, tax interview (W-8BEN) and bank are appended to action 029 as one sitting (~15 min) and the upload is the owner's click
items.why: Spike 2026-10-26 (new-ventures spike-kdp-sole-trader-tax-guide, docs/exchange/spikes/kdp-sole-trader-tax-guide.md): amazon.co.uk's Kindle search shows buyers counted on the shelf — a £3.99 MTD playbook with 245 ratings since 26 Aug 2026, a £9.99 MTD guide (34), a £6.50 annual Self Assessment series every April since 2017 (11–36 ratings an edition) and a near-identical £4.99 'Sole Trader & Side Hustle Tax Workbook 2026/27' ebook published 21 Oct 2026; KDP lists for £0, bills and remits VAT, pays 70 % of the ex-VAT price less £0.10/MB (£2.70 on £4.99), requires AI-generated text to be disclosed and allows it, and its content-quality rules bar companion books, incomplete books and adverts — which fixes the shape as a complete original guide. STRATEGY §1: a shelf with its own buyers for the line already validated; the same content, a second shelf, half the net per copy and no fee. Proof as the §4 Etsy row: first sale within 30 days of listing, ≥ 10 within 60, read from KDP's sales report (the owner pastes the month's count into a note; no mail parsing). Score: evidence 2 × reach 2 ÷ (1 day + 20 owner minutes) ≈ 3. Done 2026-10-26 (burn-down): ventures/tax-workbook/src/kindle builds the EPUB (17 sections, 9,102 words, epubcheck 0/0) and the 1600×2560 cover with npm run kindle; every figure computed from rates.ts/tax.ts; the workbook named once in the colophon (tested); KINDLE.md listing pack + kdp.ts; action 029 step 5 raised; kdp-listing-live queued.
items.proof: ventures/tax-workbook/kindle/ builds the EPUB and cover with npm run kindle, RESEARCH.md §5 carries the guide's outline and the KDP disclosure, action 029 gains the KDP step, and the listing is live with its first sale within 30 days

items.title: List the Kindle guide EPUB on Google Play Books after the KDP Select term: `src/kindle/google-play.ts` exporting the Play listing (title, description with the AI-authorship line, categories, £4.99 GBP for territory GB, Google Books preview setting) with form-limit tests beside kdp.ts, a 'Paste into Partner Centre' section in KINDLE.md, and action 029 step 6 for the owner (open the Partner Centre with the Foundry Google account, payments profile, upload the same EPUB and cover, ~10 min, £0); then a `google-play-listing-live` record item on the owner's URL
items.why: Spike google-play-books-tax-guide-shelf 2026-10-26 (docs/exchange/spikes/google-play-books-tax-guide-shelf.md). Google's own pages: the United Kingdom is ticked for seller sign-ups and GBP payments; 70 % of the list price with no fees and no price band; the content policies carry no rule on AI-written text. Seven priced UK tax guides for 2026 sell on the GB shelf at £2.29–19.99 (two at five stars). Zero build beyond the metadata export — the EPUB, cover and copy exist. Blocked on KDP Select: kdp.ts enrols the guide (the Countdown Deal needs it) and Select forbids selling the ebook on any other shelf during each 90-day term; on Amazon's ~88 % UK share the launch price on the big shelf outweighs an early listing on the small one. `kdp-listing-live` sets this item's not_before to the live date + 90 days (and the owner is told not to renew Select unless Kindle Unlimited reads are paying); the owner declining Select unblocks it at once. Evidence 1.5 × reach 2 ÷ 0.3 days + 10 owner minutes ≈ 6.
items.proof: google-play.ts exports the listing and its tests pass; KINDLE.md carries the Partner Centre paste section; action 029 step 6 written; the live URL recorded by the follow-up item
items.blocked_on: KDP Select 90-day exclusivity: the Kindle listing enrols for its Countdown Deal, so the ebook may not be sold elsewhere until the first term ends — kdp-listing-live sets not_before = live + 90 days; the owner declining Select unblocks it at once

items.why: Exchange 2026-W44 (docs/exchange/2026-W44.md, run 2026-10-29): the line's three products are finished and every listing waits on action 029 (open since 10-24, no reply; eight owner asks open), and the W43 exchange named our own Stripe link as the fallback shelf. This is the one listing that needs no new account, identity check or fee: the Stripe account, merchant-of-record setup, licence Worker and product pages already sell ReadFocus. Evidence 3 (172 sales at £7.19 from a one-listing Etsy shop, ≈ 1,500 reviews on the VAT sibling — RESEARCH §2) × reach 1 (apps.gankdat.com's own ranking; ReadFocus pages draw ≈ 20 impressions a week) ÷ (0.5 d + 3 owner min) ≈ 5, weight 2. STRATEGY §6: distribution before features. Beats the baseline (gankdat facet-aggregation-one-scan, 7 × 1).

items.title: Submit the workbook to Payhip's marketplace once the store has US$10 of its own sales (the eligibility rule in Payhip's Marketplace article, read 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-29): raise the one-click owner step (Category & Tags tab → Submit to marketplace, ~1 min) and record the approval (aim 10 days) in RESEARCH.md §7
items.why: Payhip's marketplace recommends products to buyers outside the store's own following at no extra fee, but admits a store only after US$10 of total sales (self-purchases excluded) and a review; digital products only, each product approved separately. The Daily numbers `payhip 30d:` reading (and the §7 Sale rows) say when the bar is met — about two sales of the £6.99 workbook. Reach is the only thing this shelf lacks, so the submission is the lever worth one owner minute.
items.proof: the store is admitted and the product approved on the marketplace; sales from marketplace traffic appear in the Payhip summary within 30 days of approval
items.blocked_on: US$10 of Payhip sales (gross_pence ≥ ~800 in the /hooks/payhip/summary reading, or two Sale rows in RESEARCH.md §7 from Payhip); then a ~1-minute owner click raised as an action step
